newsitem.title: UK: CWC extends offer for Bell Cable, NYNEX Cable.
newsitem.headline: CWC extends offer for Bell Cable, NYNEX Cable.

text.p: Britain's Cable and Wireless Communications Plc said on Tuesday it had extended its offers for Bell Cablemedia Plc and NYNEX CableComms Group to June 16.
From Monday, CWC said it had valid acceptances covering about 99.6 percent of Bell Cablemedia's ordinary shares and some 95.6 percent of NYNEX CableComms' ordinary share capital.
The offers were declared unconditional in all respects on April 28.
CWC, the new cable telephone and television company in Britain, was formed by the merger of the Mercury unit of Cable and Wireless Plc with the cable units of NYNEX Corp and Bell Canada.
